author: mrfillbert
quote: I was 19 in 1997 when GTA came out. Since then, I have been a solid fan playing each release. This release is a huge disappointment. The graphics, playability, are amazing. The team did great work delivering a nice-looking game.  But they removed everything that made this GTA!  Where are the hookers? Stash house? my belligerent chaos. Now you can't do this and that.   Thanks for the diet coke version of GTA.   Less then 1 calorie!
